leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the outgoing nerve route was the least informative passage. Its indirect path through the spinal cord and neck is striking, but why it takes that route is not explained.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the nerve route to the pineal location passes through the spinal cord and a neck nerve cluster.
